devices.reason: An MCDM device; WSL2's GPU-PV forwards WDDM display adapters only, so it has no device node here and nothing installed inside WSL reaches it. Measured 5.3x the CPU on a 1024x2048x2048 GEMM. See vllm_omni/edge/npu_ryzenai.py.
